run_make_changelog: run the make_changelog script to extract changelog entries from closed GitHub issues with the needs changelog label
extract_changelog_entries: extract suggested changelog entries from GitHub issue bodies using the ENTRY regex pattern
list_issues_needing_changelog: list closed GitHub issues labeled needs changelog for the pybind11 repository using ghapi
format_changelog_with_rich: format changelog entries with RST syntax highlighting using rich.syntax.Syntax for terminal output
report_missing_changelog: report GitHub issues that are missing a suggested changelog entry and display the template format
